carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a light-to-dark vertical luminance gradient, extending from the post-cranial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse and diffuse high-luminance blobs visible within the dorsal fin macro-mask, primarily concentrated along the lower anterior and mid-sections.
